entries.wording: We’ve received your delivery details. We’ll let you know as soon as your parcel is in our hands.
entries.note: The shipper's label data, before DAI Post holds the parcel. Its clock is not the origin hub's, so it stays a local time.

entries.wording: Customer label information received
Your parcel’s checked in and being prepared for its journey.
entries.note: The first scan at DAI Post's origin hub.

entries.wording: Checked in at origin hub
We’ve processed your parcel at our origin facility. Next, on the move to you!
Parcel processed at origin facility
We’ve processed your parcel at our origin facility. Next, on the move to you!
Parcel processed at origin facility
There’s a departure delay. Thanks for your patience, we’ll update you soon.
entries.note: A delay before the flight leaves; the parcel stays in transit.

entries.wording: There’s a transit delay. Thanks for your patience, we’ll update you soon.
entries.note: A delay on the way; the parcel stays in transit.

entries.wording: Your parcel is in the air and is heading your way.
Parcel departed origin country
Parcel arrived in trans-shipment country.
Your parcel’s left the transfer country and is back on the move.
Touchdown! Your parcel has landed.
Parcel arrived in destination country
We’ve collected your parcel from the airline and it’s being processed.
Collected from the airline for processing
Your parcel is being checked by customs. We’ll let you know when it’s cleared.
Parcel processed by clearance facility
entries.note: Handed to the clearance facility; customs has not released it yet.

entries.wording: Customs clearance delay
entries.note: Customs still holds the parcel, in one case for GST.

entries.wording: All clear! Your parcel’s passed customs and is ready for the next leg.
Customs cleared
We’ve got your parcel and it’s been sorted for delivery.
Parcel received and sorted
Your parcel’s on an interstate journey. We’ll keep you updated as it travels.
Your parcel’s arrived at our local facility, it's on the way.
Your parcel’s on its way to you, almost there!
entries.note: Handed on towards the delivery depot, not yet on a delivery round.

entries.wording: It’s happening, your parcel will be delivered today. Get ready!
Parcel out for final mile carrier delivery
Parcel unsafe to leave at address
entries.note: The courier did not leave the parcel.

entries.wording: Parcel available for collection
entries.note: The tracker links the scan's town to a map: the point holding the parcel.

entries.wording: Delivered! Your parcel has arrived. Enjoy!
Delivered, left where you can find it.
entries.note: Left at the address with the recipient's authority.

entries.wording: Parcel delivered - authority to leave
